jobs.name: tests_hybrid_gpu
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p results && {python} -m pytest -s -p no:warnings -rA tests/test_armt.py tests/test_training.py tests/test_pretrained.py -k 'qwen' > results/{name}.txt 2>&1; tail -3 results/{name}.txt
